name: dl-lbz-tower-1
prompt: Photorealistic aerial drone photograph, vertical 9:16, of Lutyens' Delhi, New Delhi, India: wide tree-lined avenues, dense green canopy of neem and jamun trees, large low-rise whitewashed colonial bungalows with red-tile and flat roofs, roundabouts, in the far distance India Gate faintly visible in light haze. Rising from the very centre of this low-rise green neighbourhood is ONE single ultra-modern 60-storey glass skyscraper, sharp and shocking, it towers far above everything, clearly out of place. Golden hour, warm low sun from the left, long shadows, slight atmospheric haze, shot from about 250 m altitude looking slightly down at a 35 degree angle, the skyscraper occupies the centre of the frame from the middle third to near the top, leave the top 25% of the frame as calm sky with no objects. Shot on a DJI Mavic 3 Pro, 24mm, ultra detailed, natural colours, professional cinematic documentary look, no text, no logos, no people visible.
